title: reconcile the readJson parse-error warning across runtimes: invariant-prefix shape assertion in the normalizer + a corrupt-JSON scenario, so every later group can cover unparseable stores
action: Found by the rpl-2 goal-check and settled by its own decision rather than another per-group deliberate_exceptions line. THE PROBLEM: packages/bee/lib/fsutil.mjs:42 warns `bee: could not parse JSON at ${file} — ${err.message}` where err.message is V8's parser text; crates/bee-core/src/fsutil.rs:82-88 emits the same sentence with serde_json's text. The two can NEVER match byte-for-byte, and crates/bee-parity/src/normalize.rs:172-198 rightly refuses any asymmetric stderr strip — so today there is nowhere to reconcile it, and every remaining ledger group would silently omit the unparseable-store shape from its scenarios. Measured blast radius (from the goal-check, do not re-derive): JSONL reads are UNAFFECTED because readJsonl skips corrupt lines silently on both sides (fsutil.mjs:112-130 / fsutil.rs:139-160); whole-JSON reads ARE exposed — reviews.mjs:109,128, feedback.mjs:547,772, decisions.mjs:127 (taxonomy), plus state.mjs (11 sites) and cells.mjs (6) which nearly every command transits. THE FIX, following exactly the precedent rpl-1 set for the `[bee] <cmd> <n>ms` line — a DECLARED artifact, shape-asserted in both directions, never a blanket ignore: teach normalize.rs to recognize this one warning and split it into an INVARIANT PREFIX and a PARSER TAIL. The prefix — everything through `bee: could not parse JSON at <path> — ` including the path — must be asserted BYTE-IDENTICAL on both legs; only the tail after that separator may differ, and the tail must still be non-empty on both legs and must be checked to actually LOOK like a parser message on each side rather than being accepted unconditionally. A leg that emits no such warning where the other does is a diff, not a pass. Name the allowance in the volatile-field docs the same way the [bee] artifact is named, so a reader can see exactly what is permitted to differ and why. FIRST, before writing the rule: confirm the mjs sentence's exact shape by running the real packages/bee/lib/fsutil.mjs over a deliberately unparseable file in a node child, and quote its output verbatim in the worker block — the em dash, the spacing and whether a trailing period or newline is present are all load-bearing and must not be assumed from the source text. THEN register at least one --cmd-check scenario in the `seam` group that reads an UNPARSEABLE whole-JSON store through a command both runtimes already support and proves the reconciliation works end to end, with its own declared mutation target and a control that fires. This cell registers NO ledger group and ports no group logic.

trace.outcome: readJson's parse-failure warning is now a DECLARED stderr artifact: invariant prefix (path included) and invariant suffix compared byte-for-byte, only the parser tail replaced with <PARSE_ERROR>, and only when it matches the producing runtime's own parser dialect. A leg that emits no warning where the other does, an empty tail, a prose tail, or the other runtime's dialect are all diffs. Proven end to end by the new seam/unparseable-whole-json-store cmd-check scenario over the real binaries, whose control makes the store parseable again so the warning vanishes on one leg.

(a) replacement not removal — test :829 asserts warned != silent; a shape Err surfaces as a diff at differ.rs:142-170, never swallowed. (b) wrong dialect refused BOTH ways, verified from the predicates not just the tests: serde text on the mjs leg fails is_v8_json_parse_message (:401) because has_position_clause needs ' at position <digits>' which serde never emits; V8 text on the queen-bee leg fails is_serde_json_parse_message (:424) because it requires rsplit_once(' at line ') and V8 writes '(line 1 column 3)'. Table-tested :872-892.

V8 predicate (:401-417) is a closed 3-family set and rejects arbitrary prose, anything lacking a position clause, and serde's dialect. serde predicate (:424-430) requires a non-empty reason plus ' at line <d> column <d>' at the very end and rejects V8's parenthetical form and an empty reason. Both no-position-clause V8 families accepted (:403, :407-409) and covered by :907-935. Empty tail short-circuits false at :369.
